bio: Once the working residence to Duxford RAF base commander, The Lodge now boasts a modern setting in a beautiful village location.  Enjoy a Rustic Afternoon Tea in the Dining Room, one of the private Glasshouses or in the Courtyard Garden. Upgrade to Prosecco or Champagne for those special occasions.  The menu features Afternoon Tea favourites, including Cucumber & Cream Cheese, Smoked Salmon and Honey Roast Ham & Mustard sandwiches.  Rustic Afternoon Tea costs from £17.95 per person. Children can also enjoy their own Afternoon Tea for just £8.95 per child.
